subject: maths
question: The ratio of the efficiencies of two workers, P and Q, is 5 : 2. If P can complete a project in 12 days, how many days will Q take to complete the same project alone?
solution:
**Given:**

Efficiency ratio of P and Q = 5 : 2

P can complete the project in 12 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done = Efficiency × Time

For the same work, Efficiency × Time (P) = Efficiency × Time (Q)

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be the LCM of P's and Q's work days based on their efficiencies.

Efficiency of P = 5, Efficiency of Q = 2

Total work = 5 × 12 = 60 units

Work done by Q in 1 day = Total work / Q's efficiency

⇒ Work done by Q in 1 day = 60 / 2

⇒ 30 days

**∴ Q will take 30 days to complete the project alone.**
